program.name: Kettlebell Roulette
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: One kettlebell and no repeats: complexes, swings, presses, rows and core, a new pairing every day.
program.about: One kettlebell, sixty different days. Each day deals a kind of bell work, complexes, swings, legs, presses, rows, hips, core, grip and more, with a format: straight sets, supersets, a circuit, an EMOM or an AMRAP, plus a couple of cardio days. No pair comes back, and the same kind never lands two days running. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
